{# Override of pydata_sphinx_theme's built-in navbar-nav.html. The stock component renders a flat link for every entry in the root document's hidden toctree — here, all 16 example notebooks, which flooded the header with an unreadable link list. Overriding this template (mirrored in docs/source/_templates/ of the main spatialize repo) drops the toctree-derived links and replaces them with exactly three: Home + Documentation (the main spatialize project — a genuinely different Sphinx project/host, so these must be real absolute URLs; no `pathto()` equivalent exists across projects) and Examples (this site's own landing page, via `pathto()` so it resolves correctly from any page depth and stays on this site/host when browsing locally or on a PR preview). #}
